# MGT 3745 repository instructions

Read context/STANDARDS.md and the selected feature in context/FEATURES.md before editing. The normative coding rules are in context/STANDARDS.md; context/CLAUDE.md expresses the same rules for agents. If their content conflicts, identify the conflict and repair the inconsistency against STANDARDS.md.

Keep HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use descriptive camelCase JavaScript identifiers and lexical scope. Render user text with textContent. Keep form controls labeled. Preserve input if persistence fails. Explain why important code exists, and do not invent interview or test evidence.

Before declaring a feature complete, run or describe the relevant acceptance check and report what actually happened. Distinguish a discovered instruction from compliance with it. Do not fill preview context documents with invented content.
